articles.summary: Highlighting Edwina 'Curlie' Justus's journey from daydreamer to the first Black woman locomotive engineer at Union Pacific, inspiring future generations of fearless females in the supply chain.
articles.title: Full Steam Ahead - Union Pacific’s First African American Woman Locomotive Engineer

articles.summary: Lillie Drennan changed the transportation industry as the first woman to ever own a trucking firm and the first woman in Texas to hold a commercial driver's license; her legacy continues to inspire Lineage Logistics nearly 50 years after her death.
articles.title: Lillie Drennan - First Woman to Own a Trucking Firm in the US
